name: Jolo – SEO Automation & AI Content Generation
author: tryjolo

sections.description:
Jolo – SEO Automation & AI Content Generation WordPress Plugin

Jolo – SEO Automation & AI Content Generation tool connects your Jolo
account with your WordPress website, turning your content publishing
process into a fully automated workflow. When new articles are created
and published in Jolo, they are imported to WordPress automatically with
a featured image, SEO metadata, author, categories, and publishing
options all set.

Jolo acts as a SEO and content automation tool. It helps businesses
perform keyword research and analysis for SEO, discover content and
keyword gaps, write SEO-optimized articles, and manage content creation
at scale – all done automatically via dedicated AI Superheroes, even
when you are offline.

Whether you are a business owner, marketer, agency, or publisher, Jolo
helps you stay on a consistent content automation strategy and saves
you hours of manual work each week.

Main features

  • Automated content publishing – Import articles directly from your Jolo account to WordPress on a predefined schedule.
  • SEO metadata support – Import SEO titles, meta descriptions, and focus keywords for Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO (AIOSEO), SEOPress, and The SEO Framework.
  • Featured images – Automatically import featured images and assign them to imported posts.
  • Author and category mapping – Choose the WordPress author and default category for imported content.
  • One-click manual sync – Perform an instant content sync whenever you need it, without waiting for the next scheduled run.
  • Automatic 15-minute sync – WordPress polls Jolo for new content every 15 minutes via WP-Cron. No configuration required.
  • Smart duplicate protection – Each article is imported once, so the same content is never posted twice.
  • Optional IndexNow ping – When enabled, newly published articles are submitted to Bing, Yandex, and other IndexNow-compatible search engines for near-instant indexing.
  • Secure API connectivity – Connect with a read-only Jolo API key. Your WordPress credentials are never sent away from your site.

Jolo – SEO Automation & AI Content Generation is an AI-driven SEO tool
that works well for:

  • Small businesses
  • Agencies
  • Content marketers
  • SEO professionals
  • Affiliate sites
  • Publishers
  • Local businesses
  • SaaS companies
  • Content teams

Jolo helps with content automation, increasing organic visibility, and
reducing manual work.

Use cases

You will find Jolo useful if you work with:

  • Small business websites. Keep your blog alive and full of SEO content without hiring writers or posting articles manually.
  • Content marketing automation. Automate the whole content workflow from keyword gap analysis and article generation in Jolo to publication on WordPress.
  • SEO growth campaigns. Amplify content production based on high-value keywords and website keyword analysis performed with Jolo’s SEO research tools.
  • Marketing agencies. Manage SEO automation and content publishing for multiple client websites, minimising manual publishing and administrative work.
  • Specialised and affiliate websites. Consistently create SEO-optimized content to drive organic traffic and build topical authority.
  • Busy website owners. Keep to a regular publishing schedule when you are busy running your business, serving customers, or working offline.

Security by design

Jolo uses a secure, read-only API connection between your Jolo account
and your WordPress site. Your WordPress login credentials are never
shared. You can also review imported content as drafts before
publishing.

Works well with

Jolo works with the five most popular WordPress SEO plugins:

  • Yoast SEO
  • Rank Math
  • All in One SEO (AIOSEO)
  • SEOPress
  • The SEO Framework

External services

This plugin connects to the Jolo API (https://tryjolo.com) to fetch
your published articles and mark them as live after import. It runs
only when you have configured a Jolo API key.

Data sent to Jolo:

  • Your Jolo API key, on every request, to authenticate you.
  • On each sync: the ID of the website attached to your Jolo account, and the timestamp of the last successful sync, so only new articles are fetched.
  • After an article is imported: the resulting WordPress post ID, its permalink, your site URL, and whether the post is published or pending – so the article is marked as live in your Jolo dashboard.

Data received from Jolo:

  • Your account profile and the list of websites attached to it, used to identify which website’s articles to sync.
  • The article content and metadata you authored in Jolo (title, body, excerpt, SEO meta, featured image).

Service terms and privacy policy:

  • Terms of Service: https://tryjolo.com/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://tryjolo.com/privacy-policy

IndexNow (optional, off by default):

When IndexNow is enabled in the plugin settings, the plugin POSTs the
permalink of each newly published article to the public IndexNow API at
https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow, along with the host name of your
site and a per-site key generated by the plugin. The key is served from
a virtual URL on your own domain so the search engine can verify
ownership. No personal data is sent to IndexNow; only the public URL
and the verification key.

IndexNow is an open protocol jointly operated by Microsoft Bing,
Yandex, Seznam, Naver and Yep. A URL submitted to the IndexNow endpoint
is shared with all participating search engines so they can crawl it.
The plugin contacts api.indexnow.org, which is operated by Microsoft
Bing as a participating IndexNow host.

  • IndexNow protocol documentation: https://www.indexnow.org/documentation
  • IndexNow getting started (Bing): https://www.bing.com/indexnow/getstarted
  • Microsoft Bing Webmaster Guidelines: https://www.bing.com/webmasters/help/webmaster-guidelines-30fba23a
  • Microsoft Privacy Statement: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement

Privacy

This plugin does not set cookies, does not track visitors, and does not
collect data from end users of your WordPress site. The only data
leaving your site is the metadata listed in the “External services”
section above, and it is sent only to the Jolo API you configure.
sections.installation:
Installing and setting up the Jolo plugin is straightforward:

  1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, choose the plugin zip, and click Install Now.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings > Jolo.
  4. Paste your API key (Integrations > WordPress in your Jolo account).
  5. Choose how new posts are saved (Draft, Pending, or Published), and click Save Changes.
  6. That’s it. New articles will be imported automatically.
sections.faq:
Does the Jolo plugin require a Jolo account?

Yes. Jolo – SEO Automation & AI Content Generation requires an active
Jolo subscription and a valid API key. The plugin links your WordPress
website to your Jolo content automation account and automatically pulls
in content created and published there.

How does the content flow between Jolo and WordPress?

Since Jolo is an AI content automation tool, the plugin automatically
checks your Jolo account for newly published articles on a predefined
schedule. New content, including the featured image, SEO title, and
meta description, is then imported into and published on WordPress.

Will the plugin overwrite posts that I edit in WordPress?

No. Each article is imported only once. Any modifications you make to a
post inside WordPress are preserved and never overwritten during future
syncs.

Is there a way to preview content before publishing?

Yes. You decide whether imported articles are created as drafts or as
published posts. This lets you review and approve content before it
goes live on your website, and run any additional keyword research and
analysis you want.

Is it safe to link my website to Jolo?

Yes. The plugin connects to your Jolo account using a secure, read-only
API key to fetch content. Jolo never receives your WordPress login
credentials, and only your published Jolo articles flow from Jolo to
your WordPress site.
